notes.title: Pokémon adventure — transformations and responsive Pokédex
notes.text: All transformation systems are enabled by default: Mega, Primal, Ultra Burst, Dynamax/Gigantamax, Terastallization/Stellar, Z-Moves, fusion and species-specific forms. Configure equipment, mixed-system allowances and Trainer use in Settings. Transform alongside an attack; original individual data is retained on reversion. Fusion uses an actually owned partner and can be reversed. Includes indexed 97 Mega and 34 Gigantamax forms, shared item equipment, main-chat context, replayable branch history, responsive Pokédex cards and incremental search that preserves typing focus.
